card.name: Inside brand drug names
card.fires_on: Partway through capitalized brand names split into pieces, such as PEG-AS-YS, BEVES-PI, DU-OPA, LET-YBO and L-UP-KYNIS. Also fires weakly on a few other mid-phrase pieces like "the" in "all the way".

modes.label: Brand name pieces
modes.description: A middle piece of an uppercase brand name in dosing or administration text.

modes.label: Other split phrases
modes.description: Occasional pieces of hyphenated or ordinary phrases outside brand names.

card.writes: The promoted and suppressed tokens are mixed and unrelated, so they suggest no clear output effect.
card.plain: It lights up in the middle of a brand drug name written in capitals, before the name is finished.
